request: Redundant printed landmarks with per-landmark visibility; preserve existing reliable reference when individual marks are occluded
scope: Offline identified-landmark geometry, source-selection logic, visual diagnostic and one automatic ROI128 patch candidate; no training or hardware action
visibility: Per point: visibly localizable/partial/unknown/occluded. Missing individual mark never implies every static reference is missing.

fixed_baseline.old_reference_policy: If old ring accepted, use its exact original pose/calibration/output; new missing or conflicting points do not withdraw it
fixed_baseline.new_reference_policy: Only consider new pose when old ring rejected. Never select by true PSI, final output error or GT visibility in automatic mode.
fixed_baseline.baseline_G: 21/56 gauge outputs on G59; preserving these does not alone establish improved overall reliability

template_setup.source: Fixed D025 train image has clear static logos; D002 logos are needle-contaminated and not patch templates
template_setup.angle_zero: D_002, train-only alignment using shared visible static identities
template_setup.input: Automatic query only U8 ROI128 plus unchanged predicted hub and locator radius
template_setup.G_visibility: Evaluation/diagnostic only, never used to prune automatic detections or enable inference

geometry.type: Orientation-preserving similarity, translation and scale; NOT full perspective rectification
geometry.ambiguous_competing_fit: Reject if another valid fit differs by>5deg, has at least the same inlier count, and RMS<=winnerRMS+0.5pixel

metrics: Per-point visible/unknown, localisation errors where labels exist
Reference support and ambiguity by scene
Correct outputs, new errors and lost correct outputs at0.25/0.5/1psi descriptive bands
Frontal subset and original rejection subset
Actual candidate memory/operation cost, without claiming MCU fit
success: Keep all old accepted observations unchanged and quantify any correct new reading recovery with new-error risks; diagnostic landmarks are not automatic detections
stop: No useful new correct outputs or added unsafe errors: preserve old reader and failed evidence, no G threshold/identity changes
no_actions: No H test or ABC reserve use

roles.training_adapter: One automatic static-patch locator and measured cost
